disciplinary_grounds.description: Firm has disciplinary actions in other jurisdictions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A firm that applies or registers pursuant to this section shall list in its application or registration all jurisdictions in which the firm has any disciplinary actions, other than for failure to timely renew a registration, license or permit, by any other jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Firm fails to maintain a simple majority of CPA ownership.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: shall notify the board in writing within one month of any change in owners that results in less than a simple majority of the ownership in terms of direct and indirect financial interests and voting rights that belong to holders in good standing of certificates or licenses as certified public accountants in any jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board member's certificate is on probation, revoked, or suspended, resulting in automatic termination of appointment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a member's certificate is on probation, revoked or suspended, the member's appointment automatically terminates and the position becomes vacant.

definition_quote.quote: experience in the practice of accounting. The applicant's experience must be sufficient to demonstrate the applicant's ability for critical inquiry and analysis of financial accounting information, including balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements or tax returns and the applicant's ability to communicate, either orally or in writing, on the results of an inquiry or analysis of that information to an employer, client or third party.

scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.item: Consent to personal and subject matter jurisdiction of the board
Consent to disciplinary authority of the board
Agreement to comply with the state's public accountancy statutes and board rules
Cessation of practice if home-state license is no longer valid
Appointment of home-state board as agent for service of process
Cessation of practice upon conviction of a crime involving dishonesty
Cessation of practice if barred by the SEC or PCAOB
Cessation of practice if any governmental body suspends the right to practice before it
Reporting pending criminal charges to the board
Consent to jurisdiction of host-state courts
Firm employing individual with practice privileges also deemed to consent to all conditions
